description: Calculate your GPA on a 4.0 scale from courses, grades and credits (+/- supported).

faqs.a: Add each course with its name, letter grade and credit hours, then click Calculate GPA.
faqs.q: How do I calculate my GPA?

faqs.a: Yes — A+ through F including all +/- variants, mapped to the standard 4.0 scale (A = 4.0, A- = 3.7, B+ = 3.3, etc.).
GPA = Σ (grade points × credits) ÷ Σ credits. Courses with more credits weigh more.
Yes — courses are stored in this browser's localStorage.
